SELECT id, user_id,title,content,location,category,organizer,audience_scope,contact_info, join_method,qrcode_url,start_time,end_time,enroll_deadline,max_participants,comment_count, like_count,view_count,published_at,
CASE WHEN status IN (0, 1, 5, 6, 7) THEN status WHEN NOW() >= end_time THEN 4 WHEN NOW() >= start_time THEN 3 ELSE 2 END AS status
FROM activity WHERE id = #{activityId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT a.id, a.title, LEFT(a.content, 160) AS summary, a.category, a.effective_status AS status, a.audit_status, a.organizer, a.location, a.audience_scope, a.is_pinned AS pinned, COALESCE(enrollment.subscriber_count, 0) AS subscriber_count, a.max_participants AS capacity, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.enroll_deadline, a.view_count, a.updated_at FROM ( SELECT id, title, content, category, audit_status, organizer, location, audience_scope, is_pinned, max_participants, start_time, end_time, enroll_deadline, view_count, updated_at, CASE WHEN status IN (0, 1, 5, 6, 7) THEN status WHEN NOW() >= end_time THEN 4 WHEN NOW() >= start_time THEN 3 ELSE 2 END AS effective_status FROM activity WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
AND (
id = #{keywordId} OR
MATCH(title, content, organizer) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) )
) a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT activity_id, COUNT(*) AS subscriber_count FROM activity_enrollment WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY activity_id ) enrollment ON enrollment.activity_id = a.id WHERE 1 = 1
AND a.effective_status = #{status}
AND a.category = #{category}
AND (a.audience_scope & #{audienceMask}) != 0
AND ( a.updated_at < (SELECT updated_at FROM activity WHERE id = #{lastId}) OR (a.updated_at = (SELECT updated_at FROM activity WHERE id = #{lastId}) AND a.id < #{lastId}) )
AND ( a.start_time > (SELECT start_time FROM activity WHERE id = #{lastId}) OR (a.start_time = (SELECT start_time FROM activity WHERE id = #{lastId}) AND a.id > #{lastId}) )
AND ( COALESCE(enrollment.subscriber_count, 0) < ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_enrollment WHERE activity_id = #{lastId} AND status = 1 ) OR ( COALESCE(enrollment.subscriber_count, 0) = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_enrollment WHERE activity_id = #{lastId} AND status = 1 ) AND a.id < #{lastId} ) )
ORDER BY a.start_time ASC, a.id ASC
ORDER BY subscriber_count DESC, a.id DESC
ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC, a.id DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(effective_status = 2), 0) AS enrolling, COALESCE(SUM(effective_status = 3), 0) AS ongoing, COALESCE(SUM(effective_status = 1), 0) AS reviewing, COALESCE(SUM(effective_status = 2 AND start_time > NOW() AND start_time <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)), 0) AS starting_soon FROM ( SELECT start_time, CASE WHEN status IN (0, 1, 5, 6, 7) THEN status WHEN NOW() >= end_time THEN 4 WHEN NOW() >= start_time THEN 3 ELSE 2 END AS effective_status FROM activity WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ) activity_summary

SELECT id, user_id, title, content, location, category, organizer, audience_scope, contact_info, join_method, qrcode_url, start_time, end_time, enroll_deadline, max_participants, CASE WHEN status IN (0, 1, 5, 6, 7) THEN status WHEN NOW() >= end_time THEN 4 WHEN NOW() >= start_time THEN 3 ELSE 2 END AS status, audit_status, reject_reason, is_pinned, comment_count, like_count, view_count, published_at, created_at, updated_at FROM activity WHERE id = #{activityId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE activity SET status = 1, audit_status = 0, reject_reason = NULL, is_pinned = FALSE WHERE id = #{activityId} AND status IN (0, 6) AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE activity SET status = 5, is_pinned = FALSE WHERE id = #{activityId} AND status = 2 AND NOW() < start_time AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE activity SET status = 4, end_time = NOW(), is_pinned = FALSE WHERE id = #{activityId} AND status IN (2, 3) AND NOW() >= start_time AND NOW() < end_time AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE activity SET status = 2, audit_status = 1, reject_reason = NULL, published_at = COALESCE(published_at, NOW()) WHERE id = #{activityId} AND status IN (1, 6) AND audit_status IN (0, 2) AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE activity SET status = 6, audit_status = 2, reject_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{activityId} AND status IN (1, 6) AND audit_status IN (0, 2) AND deleted_at IS NULL
